items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: Bobby Rosengarden helped me by hiring me at NBC, getting NBC to hire me as his sub

ctx.x: And I’ve had a lot of people help me. A friend of yours, Bobby Rosengarden helped me by hiring me at NBC, getting NBC to hire me as his sub so he could go out and make more money recording. Bobby was a great guy, I liked him, I always liked him. And he was a boisterous kind of guy and would run around hollering and screaming and all like that. But he was a much better drummer than people gave him credit for.
Um hum. He’s been up to the college a number of times too.
